fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami municipal contracting and support for local printing, a jury verdict in the Osius case and concerns about reckless driving on the causeway, and guidance on treating convention visitors fairly as Miami seeks major conventions. Additional pieces discuss Florida Power & Light rates and their impact on renters and property owners, transportation issues including causeway streetcar hazards and jitney removal, plans for two landing fields (Hialeah and Venetian causeway), and local civic and business notes, humor columns, and sports/boxing coverage and advertisements.
